# Trigger Matrix

## Must trigger

- Create a new territory card.
- Redraw Territory 255A from the real streets.
- Fix the boundary colors on this territory map.
- Convert this old territory PDF into the current card design.
- Find gaps between our territory cards.
- Make all internal streets visible and work both sides.
- The perimeter streets are work inside only.
- Put this area into a territory map.
- Update the Canva territory card without changing the verified streets.
- The top of the territory map is cut off.
- Add the verified apartment-complex name and its named entrances.
- Shrink the supplied map uniformly and add connected major cross roads.

## Must not trigger

- Explain the history of territorial Michigan.
- Draw a fantasy kingdom map.
- Build a sales territory dashboard.
- Give me driving directions to Detroit.
- Summarize a political border dispute.
- Create a generic neighborhood illustration with fictional streets.

## Competing skills

- Territory skill owns street geometry, boundary meaning, coverage, and work rules.
- PDF skill owns PDF mechanics and final render verification.
- Canva skill owns approved styling edits after geometry is verified.
- Image generation must not own real street geometry.
